findings.F1: In the tested situation (falling calm, 30-day return below 0, the `trending` regime), the quieter the last 30 days' mean volume against the last 90 days' mean volume, the larger the next 5-day fall. The graded measure is -0.0339 with a day-clustered t of -2.58 (81 non-overlapping cases on 30 days), and the quartiles of that ratio are monotone: -5.23 % (t -2.96, 21 cases), -3.10 % (t -1.59), -0.18 % and +3.75 % (t +1.76) of 5-day excess return, from quietest to heaviest.
findings.F2: The tested baseline, 30-day volume against the 365 days before, standardised, predicts nothing in the same cases. Its graded t is 0.09 on 246 cases (97 days), and it correlates only 0.18 with the 30-against-90-day ratio, so the idea's volume measure missed the comparison that carries the effect.
findings.F3: Split at the median of the 30-against-90-day ratio inside the situation, the quiet half falls in 2018 and 2019 and on every coin it reaches, while the heavy half sits near 0 or rises.
findings.F4: The quiet-volume continuation lives in calm declines. Among grid cases with a 30-day fall, the same graded measure is -0.0262 (t -1.81, 58 cases) when the 60-day trend is falling and the market is calm. It is -0.0006 (t -0.02, 86 cases) when falling and agitated, +0.0188 (t +0.90, 15 cases) when choppy and calm, and +0.0425 (t +2.31, 202 cases) after a 30-day rise, where it points the other way.
findings.F5: Over all grid cases with a 30-day fall, only the quietest fifth of the 30-against-90-day ratio is followed by a fall: -4.26 % of 5-day excess return (t -2.70, 36 cases), against +0.07 %, -0.11 % and -0.38 % for the three heaviest fifths.
findings.F6: The tested book could not pay. Its total move per case is -0.08 % against a 0.19 % trade cost, because the short fights the coin's normal drift of -0.67 % in its direction. The book's daily returns correlate -0.38 with the coins' and it earned +2.2 % a year. The quietest quartile's move in F1, about -5 % in 5 days, is many times that cost.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, after a coin has fallen over its last 30 days, the quieter its mean volume over those 30 days compared with its mean volume over the last 90 days, the more it keeps falling over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader in a calm downtrend would short a coin whose recent fall came on volume thinner than in its last three months, larger the thinner it is, and stay out when recent volume is heavier than in those months.
ideas.name: quiet volume against three months
